## What and why

## How it was checked
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior (offline, no keys)
- [ ] README updated if a command, flag or behavior changed

## Safety
- [ ] No API keys, `.env`, discovery output or real supplier contacts in this change
- [ ] The two-proof verification rule is unchanged, or the change is explained above
- [ ] Any new paid API call has a cap or budget option

## Accuracy claims
If this changes classification, enrichment or verification: sample size, who judged it, and what was not tested.
